title: Pieter Levels on Twitch: ship ugly MVPs, stay indie, price for max revenue, automate everything
summary: Four-hour AMA where Levels explains why scrappy, ugly products win, why he avoids VC and ads, and how he prices Nomad List and Remote OK. He covers error reporting via Telegram, lifetime pricing vs churn, motivation hacks, and building communities.

principles.text: Ship an ugly first version; early Google also looked bad, and polish isn't what customers pay for.
principles.quote: if you look at the first page of the first version of Google, it also looks shit. So all the first versions look shit.
